title: Primes of prime and principal localizations
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal and $A=R_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. (1) Contraction along $R\to A$ gives an inclusion-preserving bijection from the primes $Q'\subset A$ to the primes $\mathfrak q\subseteq\mathfrak p$ of $R$, with inverse $\mathfrak q\mapsto\mathfrak qA$. (2) For any $t\in A$ and $B=A[1/t]$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away], contraction along $A\to B$ gives an inclusion-preserving bijection from the primes $Q\subset B$ to the primes $Q'\subset A$ with $t\notin Q'$, with inverse $Q'\mapsto Q'B$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00E3 (lemma-spec-localization, line 3163), applied to the complement of a prime and to the powers of one element; both applications occur in the proof of Lemma Tag 031R (lemma-criterion-reduced, lines 43965-43972)
